verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local iOS terminal with programmatic surfaces (Shortcuts actions and an optional relay server), so asking whether it offers an isolated test environment is fair. The evidence says there is "no test environment" and that in-app commands share the app's sandbox and can read its credential files. The iOS per-app sandbox and `pickFolder` access are host-platform features, not a product-provided test environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
